mapper.insert: /* PT 프로젝트 등록 proposal.insertProject */ INSERT INTO tb_pt_project ( PT_PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NM, ORG_NM, PROJECT_OVERVIEW, TARGET_TYPE_CD, DUE_DT, RFP_FILE_ID, EVAL_TABLE_FILE_ID, STATUS_CD, WRITING_GUIDELINE_JSON, PROJECT_CONFIG_JSON, CREATE_DT, CREATE_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{ptProjectId}, #{projectNm}, #{orgNm}, #{projectOverview}, #{targetTypeCd}, #{dueDt}, #{rfpFileId}, #{evalTableFileId}, #{statusCd}, #{writingGuidelineJson}, #{projectConfigJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createUserId} )
mapper.select: /* PT 프로젝트 단건 조회 proposal.selectProject */ SELECT PT_PROJECT_ID AS ptProjectId , PROJECT_NM AS projectNm , ORG_NM AS orgNm , PROJECT_OVERVIEW AS projectOverview , TARGET_TYPE_CD AS targetTypeCd , DATE_FORMAT(DUE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dueDt , RFP_FILE_ID AS rfpFileId , EVAL_TABLE_FILE_ID AS evalTableFileId , STATUS_CD AS statusCd , CAST(WRITING_GUIDELINE_JSON AS CHAR) AS writingGuidelineJson , CREATE_USER_ID AS createUserId , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createDt , MODIFY_USER_ID AS modifyUserId , DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS modifyDt FROM TB_PT_PROJECT WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId}

/* PT 파일 단건 조회 proposal.selectPtFileById */ SELECT PT_FILE_ID AS ptFileId , PT_PROJECT_ID AS ptProjectId , FILE_PURPOSE_CD AS filePurposeCd , FILE_PATH AS filePath , FILE_NM AS fileNm , FILE_SIZE AS fileSize , FILE_TYPE AS fileType , CREATE_USER_ID AS createUserId , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createDt FROM TB_PT_FILE WHERE PT_FILE_ID = #{ptFileId}

/* PT 요구사항 목록 조회 proposal.selectRequirements */ SELECT REQUIREMENT_ID AS requirementId , PT_PROJECT_ID AS ptProjectId , REQ_NO AS reqNo , REQ_CATEGORY_CD AS reqCategoryCd , REQ_CONTENT AS reqContent , MANDATORY_YN AS mandatoryYn , SOURCE_TYPE_CD AS sourceTypeCd , RFP_PAGE_REF AS rfpPageRef , EVAL_IMPACT AS evalImpact , RESPONSE_DIRECTION AS responseDirection , REQUIRED_EVIDENCE AS requiredEvidence , CONFIRM_NEEDED_YN AS confirmNeededYn , CONFIRM_NEEDED_NOTE AS confirmNeededNote , SORT_ORD AS sortOrd , CREATE_USER_ID AS createUserId , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createDt FROM TB_PT_REQUIREMENT WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, REQUIREMENT_ID

/* PT 평가기준 목록 조회 proposal.selectEvalCriteria */ SELECT EVAL_CRITERIA_ID AS evalCriteriaId , PT_PROJECT_ID AS ptProjectId , EVAL_ITEM_NM AS evalItemNm , SCORE AS score , EVAL_INTENT AS evalIntent , HIGH_SCORE_CONDITION AS highScoreCondition , REQUIRED_EVIDENCE AS requiredEvidence , DIFFERENTIATION_DIRECTION AS differentiationDirection , SLIDE_REFLECT_POSITION AS slideReflectPosition , SORT_ORD AS sortOrd , CREATE_USER_ID AS createUserId , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createDt FROM TB_PT_EVAL_CRITERIA WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, EVAL_CRITERIA_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PT_PROBLEM_DEFINITION ( PROBLEM_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, PROBLEM_TYPE_CD, CURRENT_PROBLEM, ROOT_CAUSE, RISK_IF_IGNORED, GOAL, REQUIRED_CAPABILITY, STRATEGY_SUMMARY, KPI, SOURCE_TYPE_CD, SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{problemId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{problemTypeCd}, #{currentProblem}, #{rootCause}, #{riskIfIgnored}, #{goal}, #{requiredCapability}, #{strategySummary}, #{kpi}, COALESCE(#{sourceTypeCd}, '002'), COALESCE(#{sortOrd}, 0), #{createUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT PROBLEM_ID AS problemId, PT_PROJECT_ID AS ptProjectId, PROBLEM_TYPE_CD AS problemTypeCd, CURRENT_PROBLEM AS currentProblem, ROOT_CAUSE AS rootCause, RISK_IF_IGNORED AS riskIfIgnored, GOAL AS goal, REQUIRED_CAPABILITY AS requiredCapability, STRATEGY_SUMMARY AS strategySummary, KPI AS kpi, SOURCE_TYPE_CD AS sourceTypeCd, SORT_ORD AS sortOrd, CREATE_USER_ID AS createUserId, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createDt FROM TB_PT_PROBLEM_DEFINITION WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, PROBLEM_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PT_WIN_THEME ( WIN_THEME_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, CORE_MESSAGE, CUSTOMER_PROBLEM, PROPOSAL_STRATEGY, EVIDENCE, EXPECTED_EFFECT, DIFFERENTIATION, SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{winThemeId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{coreMessage}, #{customerProblem}, #{proposalStrategy}, #{evidence}, #{expectedEffect}, #{differentiation}, COALESCE(#{sortOrd}, 0), #{createUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT WIN_THEME_ID AS winThemeId, PT_PROJECT_ID AS ptProjectId, CORE_MESSAGE AS coreMessage, CUSTOMER_PROBLEM AS customerProblem, PROPOSAL_STRATEGY AS proposalStrategy, EVIDENCE AS evidence, EXPECTED_EFFECT AS expectedEffect, DIFFERENTIATION AS differentiation, SORT_ORD AS sortOrd, CREATE_USER_ID AS createUserId, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createDt FROM TB_PT_WIN_THEME WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, WIN_THEME_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PT_TOC ( TOC_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, PARENT_TOC_ID, SECTION_NO, SECTION_NM, LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID, PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT, SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{tocId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{parentTocId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sectionNo}, #{sectionNm}, #{linkedEvalCriteriaId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{plannedSlideCnt}, COALESCE(#{sortOrd}, 0), #{createUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT TOC_ID AS tocId, PT_PROJECT_ID AS ptProjectId, PARENT_TOC_ID AS parentTocId, SECTION_NO AS sectionNo, SECTION_NM AS sectionNm, LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID AS linkedEvalCriteriaId, PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT AS plannedSlideCnt, SORT_ORD AS sortOrd, CREATE_USER_ID AS createUserId, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createDt FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, TOC_ID
/* Stage2 실행 여부 확인 proposal.countProblemDefinitions */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PT_PROBLEM_DEFINITION WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId}

/* TOC 단건 조회 proposal.selectTocById */ SELECT TOC_ID AS tocId, PT_PROJECT_ID AS ptProjectId, PARENT_TOC_ID AS parentTocId, SECTION_NO AS sectionNo, SECTION_NM AS sectionNm, LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID AS linkedEvalCriteriaId, PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT AS plannedSlideCnt, SORT_ORD AS sortOrd, CREATE_USER_ID AS createUserId, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createDt FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE TOC_ID = #{tocId}

/* 소목차(leaf) 목록 조회 proposal.selectLeafTocList */ SELECT TOC_ID AS tocId, PT_PROJECT_ID AS ptProjectId, PARENT_TOC_ID AS parentTocId, SECTION_NO AS sectionNo, SECTION_NM AS sectionNm, LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID AS linkedEvalCriteriaId, PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT AS plannedSlideCnt, SORT_ORD AS sortOrd FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} AND PARENT_TOC_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SORT_ORD, TOC_ID

/* 다음 소목차 조회 proposal.selectNextLeafToc */ SELECT TOC_ID AS tocId, PT_PROJECT_ID AS ptProjectId, PARENT_TOC_ID AS parentTocId, SECTION_NM AS sectionNm, SORT_ORD AS sortOrd FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} AND PARENT_TOC_ID IS NOT NULL AND SORT_ORD > ( SELECT COALESCE(SORT_ORD, 0) FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE TOC_ID = #{tocId} ) ORDER BY SORT_ORD LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: /* 슬라이드 등록 proposal.insertSlide */ INSERT INTO TB_PT_SLIDE ( SLIDE_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, TOC_ID, SLIDE_NO, COLOR_INDEX, LAYOUT_TYPE, SLIDE_JSON, IMAGE_GEN_HINT, RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH, RENDER_STATUS_CD, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{slideId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{tocId}, #{slideNo}, #{colorIndex}, #{layoutType}, #{slideJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{imageGenHint, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{renderedImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{renderStatusCd}, '001'), #{createUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: /* 소목차 슬라이드 목록 조회 proposal.selectSlidesByToc */ SELECT SLIDE_ID AS slideId, PT_PROJECT_ID AS ptProjectId, TOC_ID AS tocId, SLIDE_NO AS slideNo, COLOR_INDEX AS colorIndex, LAYOUT_TYPE AS layoutType, CAST(SLIDE_JSON AS CHAR) AS slideJson, IMAGE_GEN_HINT AS imageGenHint, RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH AS renderedImagePath, RENDER_STATUS_CD AS renderStatusCd, CREATE_USER_ID AS createUserId, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createDt, DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS modifyDt FROM TB_PT_SLIDE WHERE TOC_ID = #{tocId} ORDER BY SLIDE_NO
mapper.delete: /* 소목차 슬라이드 전체 삭제 proposal.deleteSlidesByToc */ DELETE FROM TB_PT_SLIDE WHERE TOC_ID = #{tocId}
